summary: Add @fractal/declarations for typed agent, mission and schedule authoring with canonical KDL v2 encoding

replay.detail: The authoring SDK emits declaration source only; event replay and runtime projections are unchanged.

schema.detail: No persisted schema, index or trigger changes. The generated TypeScript API represents the supported KDL declaration vocabulary.

rules.detail: Declaration admission, authority, revision validation and publication rules remain daemon-owned and unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds an independent workspace package without changing the existing HTTP client API or KDL v2 grammar. Existing declaration files remain valid.

downtime.detail: No deployment, runtime restart or migration is required.

manual.detail: Adoption is optional. Authors can import @fractal/declarations and validate its emitted KDL through the existing Fractal workflow.

recovery.detail: No new persistent state or recovery procedure; authors can continue using existing KDL declarations.
